program.name: Gentle Volume
program.subject: Gentle / low impact
program.blurb: Three longer gentle sessions: easy strength, easy cardio and balance, then a floor flow.
program.about: Gentle training with more time in it. One day is easy strength from a chair and the wall; the next marching, step-touches and arm drives with balance holds; the third a slow floor flow for the back and hips. Three days rotate. Nothing jumps. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Gentle strength / easy cardio & balance / gentle flow
